title: ADR-0141 D8 item 1: one record-to-array conversion so marketplace snapshots carry `dependencies` in `PackageDependencySchema` shape — read cloud's `manifest_json` reader first
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed — the snapshot-alignment card ADR-0141 §Execution plan item 3 names (merge question 9: its own card), owed by landed work (PR #25717, merge `afe6ab9ccc`)
Ruling: #25403 comment 6369704387 (B′, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-23T16:28:30Z), workload line: "the manifest `dependencies` record and the marketplace `PackageDependencySchema` array (`package-version.zod.ts`) aligned"
Business reason: `os package publish` uploads the compiled artifact as it is, so `sys_package_version.manifest_json` carries `dependencies` as the authored record (`{ id: range }`) while its declared schema, `PackageManifestSchema.dependencies`, is an array of `PackageDependencySchema`. Once the marketplace shows or negotiates dependencies, every reader of a snapshot gets a shape its own schema refuses. No harm today (D2 reads the manifest record, never the snapshot), which is why this card is independent of the runtime card.
Reader: the `packages/cli` lane (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`), with a first reading in `objectstack-ai/cloud` (the control-plane parser of `sys_package_version.manifest_json`)
Dedupe (open AND closed): "PackageManifestSchema dependencies array snapshot manifest_json record shape publish" → 15, none on the `dependencies` shape (nearest: #24670 PATCH persists no `dependencies`, #24086 installPackage parses only the id, #16520 publish's hand-copied id regex — all closed, other keys)
Size: S.

## What to do (ADR-0141 D8 item 1)

1. **First, read** how the control plane parses `sys_package_version.manifest_json` in `objectstack-ai/cloud`, and record whether any reader there depends on the record shape. ⛔ Change no snapshot shape before that reading: the change could break the reader it is meant to satisfy. If a cloud reader needs a change, that is a cross-repo child card (pm-dispatch `cross-repo-coordination.md`), landed before or with this one.
2. **One conversion** from record to array, used by every writer of a snapshot: one entry per key, `packageId` = the key, `versionRange` = the value, `optional` = `false` (the record has no optional arm; what `optional: true` means is D8 item 2, decided on the runtime card #25792).
3. A test that a published snapshot parses with `PackageManifestSchema`.

## Out of scope

⛔ No spec shape changes (ADR-0141 D8): the manifest record stays the authored source of truth; the array is its projection. `AppManifestSchema.dependencies` (D8 item 3) belongs to the runtime card #25792.
